status: frozen before any measured run. Rule change of 2026-11-08 (K1 exclusion rules, from the orchestrator), made before any run. The previous version is at commit de9bb85.

rules.setup: Runs before holds are enabled, through the app's own pages or endpoints. Not counted as a measured step. Logged in the edge log under the 'setup' marker.
rules.steps: Run in the browser with holds enabled. Only these steps count.
rules.goal_during_hold: The user-visible result the page must show while every unsafe request is still held and no response has been released to the page.
rules.intended_effect: The server state the task should produce, checked by read_back after release.
rules.irreversible: yes when the write has an effect outside the app (mail sent, payment taken). These are HOLD by default.
rules.native_draft_available: yes when the app offers a saved, not-final record of this write (a draft message or a saved quote). Carts and orders are not drafts.
rules.native_draft_required: yes when the goal cannot be reached without that saved record, because the task is the draft or the quote itself. Such a task cannot count for K1.
rules.native_draft_used: recorded per run: yes when the run touched the draft or quote feature at any point. A task with native_draft_used = yes does not count for K1.
rules.counts_for_k1: held_outcome is completes, faked_response is no, native_draft_used is no, unsafe_before_release is 0 (no hold leak), and read_back_match is true.
